description: This file defines a preference key for tracking view width changes, an extension on the View protocol for handling width change callbacks, and a testing utility for reducing width values during debugging.

methods.name: onWidthChange
methods.description: Adds a callback to execute when the view's width changes, utilizing GeometryReader and preference keys.

methods.name: reduceWidth
methods.description: A static method for testing purposes to compute a reduced width value from current and next values.
